entities.summary: Deepali Pant Joshi is a former executive director of the Reserve Bank of India. She is a development economist and a writer on economic subjects. Her professional responsibilities have included the Department of Currency Management Archived 6 February 2015 at the Wayback Machine, Legal Department and Premises Department. She was the First Appellate authority under the Right to Information Act, as well as the RBI nominee on the governing council of the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) and director on the board of Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL).
